user.title: Add a ZEAL-Dry zone
user.description: Create one ZEAL-Dry area and choose whether it should monitor only or use the built-in dummy ACU for safe testing.

data_description.zone_name: A unique name for this controlled area, for example Undercroft Bedroom.
data_description.temperature_entity: Home Assistant temperature sensor for this area.
data_description.humidity_entity: Home Assistant relative-humidity sensor for this area.
data_description.control_mode: Monitoring only never operates an actuator. Test / Dummy ACU creates an internal test actuator so you can watch ZEAL-Dry switch drying on and off without controlling real equipment.

error.zone_name_required: Enter a name for this ZEAL-Dry zone.
